summary: An unfilled care shift keeps a resident from a gathering inside their own building.
realLife: Shaheed missed a St. Patrick’s Day potluck at her senior apartments because she had no help getting ready.
gates: A missed shift overlaps the time a resident needs assistance to attend a scheduled gathering.
inGame: needs: an invitation, preparation assistance and an uncovered shift.

turns.pulledBy: A replacement arrives in time to help them get ready.

turns.what: A neighbor brings a plate upstairs.
turns.pulledBy: The gathering goes ahead and the neighbor knows the resident wanted to come.
turns.writesBack: The resident shares a meal at home.
